title: q_max's `checks` job (256 to 328 s serial before any test shard) is cut; re-sharding the tests is secondary
why: From the test and CI plan (docs/plans/test-ci-standard.md, merged Nov 1 18:28 CST in PR #977), lane 11 of 12, ranked by harm avoided. RE-SCOPED 01:50 CST Nov 14 (coordinator 01:48, relayed from lane ci-speed-qmax; unchecked by triage): the lane measured q_max main push runs, n=5: the `checks` job runs 256 to 328 s serially before any test shard starts; the slowest shard is 569 to 647 s; wall 14.1 to 16.4 min. Re-sharding saves about 1 to 1.5 min; moving work out of `checks` saves up to about 5 min. The coordinator's pick (undoable, its own): re-scope the step to the `checks` job; the step's earlier Option A and Option B are dropped. The build waits for #1171 and #1172 on q_max main (owner item 821, open). The sample is five runs; the lane's run ids are unread by triage.
note: Repo: q_max. Done when each shard's slowest run is under 10 minutes and each cap comment cites a measured run. Ready. Port: yes.
